caption: Immerse yourself in luxury year-round with our heated pool and two inviting hot tubs. Whether it's a snowy wonderland or a sunny paradise, these slope-side amenities offer a perfect retreat

Step into a world beyond the ordinary, where the clichés of moose and bear decor are left behind. Welcome to a Ski-in-Ski-out mountain modern haven that defies convention. Here, innovation meets style, and comfort intertwines with adventure.

Savor delicious meals together at our spacious dining table, accommodating up to 6 guests, or gather around the kitchen island for an additional 3. Our commitment to your comfort extends to providing ample basic amenities for every guest.
Step onto our private balcony – a hidden gem for creating unforgettable moments. Whether it's leisurely afternoon cocktails or a relaxing spot for après-anything!

Gather by the warm embrace of our gas fireplace, a hub of comfort and connection. With modern seating and a range of entertainment for all ages, our living area becomes the perfect haven for cozy nights in and joyful moments shared

Indulge in ultimate relaxation on our plush king bed. Wake up to mountain views and the promise of a day full of adventure. Your ensuite offers privacy and convenience, complete with mountain modern decor.

If the idea of crafting your own culinary masterpiece appeals, rest assured that our fully equipped kitchen stands ready. From pots and pans to modern appliances, the kitchen provides a canvas for your culinary visions.
